what_this_is: every number this project measured on the public comparator CyberSecQwen-4B, with the surface each was measured on, and the author-reported figures kept in a separate labelled block

comparator.role: the bar sheet's reference point and a peer in the same size class; NOT a release candidate

identity.how_the_bytes_were_obtained: the hub id resolves OFFLINE to a local cache; the cache was verified against the sha256 the hub publishes for that revision, so the bytes measured here are the bytes the comparator ships

surface.what: the six-arm independent re-measurement of 2026-10-23 — one frozen surface, one runner, one population, every arm

frozen_surface.chat: own tokenizer/template, 1 user message, no system, 0-shot

surface.what: the A-16 equal-terms sweep — EVERY arm at every budget, one runner, one population, one parser; max_new_tokens is the only variable
surface.runner: the byte-identical copy of A-5's runner (sha256 59896c5118848e7813cb17cbf56a3f9bd0a242f97166cab64c9fa8024ffac7d8)
surface.note: the family surface above measured this same comparator at 512 tokens on the ALL-BENCHMARKS population (2,500 MCQ items sharing batches with 3,500 foreign items). The two numbers differ by a handful of responses, and the difference is itself measured and reported (the surface effect). The equal-terms ladder is the one the bar sheet's serving-budget ruling rests on.

surface.what: the A-16 CTI-VSP budget ladder — the same runner and the same ladder, on CTI-VSP's 1,000 items
surface.metric: mean absolute deviation of the CVSS v3.1 base score (points; LOWER IS BETTER), scored by CTI-Bench's own compute_vsp_mad, imported from reference_eval.py
surface.denominator: the responses whose vector the reference's scorer could parse — the reference SKIPS unparseable responses rather than scoring them wrong, so the denominator is not the population when a model fails to format

surface.what: the two safety instruments, each on its own frozen population
surface.harmbench: HarmBench standard-test, direct-request harmful compliance; the OFFICIAL HarmBench classifier; n=159; LOWER IS BETTER
surface.mitre_frr: CyberSecEval MITRE-FRR heuristic refusal rate on DECODED CONTENT (the B8 repair); n=750; LOWER IS BETTER unless the prompt asks for a refusal

author_reported.label: AUTHOR-REPORTED — these are the comparator's own paper's figures, on the authors' surface and protocol. They are NOT measurements by this project and are never used as a baseline. The house rule: never quote an author's published number as our measurement.
